source.citation: Kato, T. (2020). Examination of the Coping Flexibility Hypothesis Using the Coping Flexibility Scale-Revised. Frontiers in Psychology, 11, 561731. https://doi.org/10.3389/fpsyg.2020.561731.

questions.authorPublishedEnglish: I can stop using a coping strategy that has made the situation worse.
questions.platformChinese: 如果一种应对方式让情况变得更糟，我能够停止使用它。

questions.authorPublishedEnglish: I can stop using a failed coping strategy.
questions.platformChinese: 如果某种应对方式已经失败，我能够停止使用它。

questions.authorPublishedEnglish: I do not repeat using a coping strategy that made the situation worse.
questions.platformChinese: 我不会反复使用曾让情况变得更糟的应对方式。

questions.authorPublishedEnglish: I can stop using a coping strategy that has been ineffective.
questions.platformChinese: 如果一种应对方式没有效果，我能够停止使用它。

questions.authorPublishedEnglish: If the situation has not improved, I consider a different coping strategy.
questions.platformChinese: 如果情况没有改善，我会考虑换一种应对方式。

questions.authorPublishedEnglish: If I did not cope well, I use an alternative coping strategy.
questions.platformChinese: 如果之前应对得不好，我会尝试另一种应对方式。

questions.authorPublishedEnglish: Even if the stressful situation has worsened, I can cope by using another strategy.
questions.platformChinese: 即使压力情境变得更糟，我也能换一种方式来应对。

questions.authorPublishedEnglish: Even if I fail to cope with stress, I can come up with a new coping strategy.
questions.platformChinese: 即使没能应对好压力，我也能够想出新的应对办法。

questions.authorPublishedEnglish: I know which coping strategies are effective and which strategies are ineffective.
questions.platformChinese: 我知道哪些应对方式有效，哪些没有效果。

questions.authorPublishedEnglish: I know if a coping strategy has been successful or unsuccessful.
questions.platformChinese: 我能判断一种应对方式是否成功。

questions.authorPublishedEnglish: I cope with stress by establishing clear objectives.
questions.platformChinese: 面对压力时，我会先明确自己的目标，再采取应对行动。

questions.authorPublishedEnglish: I can grasp if a coping strategy that I have used has been working well.
questions.platformChinese: 我能够判断自己用过的应对方式是否起了作用。

notes: English items preserve published Table 1 group order, not unverified actual Japanese administration order.
Chinese translation is unvalidated; original paper dimension range 0-16 conflicts with 4*0..3, use 0..12 arithmetic.
